name: audio_max
description: Speaker driven at full output: power, current and the chain's corner

assert.name: full output into the 8 ohm speaker is about 1.5 W
assert.because: derived from the rated 3 W into 4 ohm at 5 V; the datasheet gives no 8 ohm figure

assert.name: the rail current stays inside the IP5306's boost rating
assert.because: 2.1 A is the boost rating for this part number, page 3

assert.name: the input high-pass corner passes bass
no part exceeds its thermal margin at the governing ambient
